responsibility: Implements LoongArch-specific ABI computation for C-like and Rust ABIs, including floating-point aggregate eligibility analysis, XLEN/FLEN-sensitive register classification, vararg register accounting, indirect passing thresholds, and explicit integer extension attributes needed for correct register semantics.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `asm/loongarch.rs`, this file is not an inline-assembly register catalog; it computes LoongArch function ABI behavior, including FP-aggregate eligibility, XLEN/FLEN-sensitive register passing, vararg accounting, and Rust-ABI extension attributes.
